answer: A farm thus spreads across origins and burns for the distribution, while each origin still has to clear the mesa quota and the anchor admission check. Because the wander audit records the origin of every admitted key, a cluster arriving through one uplink is visible after the fact. Admission is capped at 8 new identities per origin per day, which is the limit that makes bulk registration expensive rather than impossible. That is 22 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
